purpose: Measure per-question contribution to existing calibration statistics before proposing question-balanced calibration.
data_scope: Original saved greedy MATH training calibration only; no test outcomes or new validation outputs used for calibration.
fixed_diagnostics: Step and label counts per question
Capped-question share of steps and each frozen label
Inverse squared question-mass concentration, not independent sample size
Original type-7 quartiles and a common inverse-CDF comparison of step-uniform versus question-uniform weighting
question_weight: For global statistics, each step in question q gets 1 / number_of_complete_steps_in_q; every nonempty question has total weight 1.
label_weight_diagnostic: For a class prototype, each question containing that class would have equal total mass; empty question-class combinations are reported, never fabricated.
preserve: Frozen lexical rule and existing labels for contribution counts
